claims.content: The System Administrator initiates the process to create a new user account within the system.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the process to create a new user account within the system.

claims.content: The System Administrator accesses the User Group creation screen.
The System Administrator enters the mandatory information for a new User Group: Group Code and Group Name.
The System Administrator defines the privileges for the new User Group by setting permissions (Allowed / Not Allowed) for Edit, Delete, View, Print, and New actions on specific screens.
The System Administrator saves the new User Group. The system validates that the Group Name does not already exist.
The System Administrator accesses the Individual User creation screen.
The System Administrator selects an existing User Group from a list.
The System Administrator enters the mandatory information for the individual user: User Name, Password, and Verify Password.
The System Administrator submits the new user information. The system validates that the User Name does not already exist and that the Password and Verify Password values are equal.
The system saves the new user account under the selected User Group.
A new User Group exists in the system with a unique Group Code and Group Name, and defined privileges for Edit, Delete, View, Print, and New actions.
A new Individual User account exists in the system under the specified User Group, with a unique User Name and verified password credentials.
